prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1191; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent in type and force with the shoulder findings documented at presentation. Examination revealed limited abduction and tenderness over the rotator cuff region, and imaging studies clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body area is known to this provider. Over four visits, the patient was managed with a standard course of physical therapy, anti-inflammatory medication, and activity modification. Symptoms and range of motion improved steadily with each visit, and the treatment plan was tapered accordingly. Discharge from active care is anticipated pending final reassessment. Note that two similar billing entries on the same date of service are currently under administrative review.
